component.name: LiveTVGuide

Label.text: Up/Down: channels Left/Right: schedule OK: watch live

component.script:
sub init() m.rows = m.top.findNode("rows") m.nowPlayingTimer = m.top.findNode("nowPlayingTimer") m.detailPoster = m.top.findNode("detailPoster") m.detailTitle = m.top.findNode("detailTitle") m.detailTime = m.top.findNode("detailTime") m.detailDescription = m.top.findNode("detailDescription") m.top.observeField("content", "onContentChanged") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "focusGuide") m.nowPlayingTimer.observeField("fire", "onNowPlayingTimer") m.channelIndex = 0 m.programIndex = 0 m.initialProgramSelected = false m.followNow = false m.rowHeight = 190 m.visibleRows = 3 m.channelWidth = 533 m.programGutter = 20 m.focusBorderThickness = 6 m.minimumProgramWidth = 433 m.maximumProgramWidth = 1733 m.maximumProgramDurationSeconds = 10800 m.maximumPreviousProgramSlots = 2 m.defaultFocusColor = "#67B7FF" m.nowPlayingColor = "#FFD54A" m.rowNodes = [] m.programGroups = [] m.programTiles = [] m.focusRects = [] m.nowPlayingAccents = [] m.programTimeLabels = [] m.nowPlayingTimer.control = "start" end sub
sub onContentChanged() buildRows() updateNowPlaying() selectInitialProgram() updateFocus() end sub
sub buildRows() while m.rows.getChildCount() > 0 m.rows.removeChildIndex(0) end while m.rowNodes = [] m.programGroups = [] m.programTiles = [] m.focusRects = [] m.nowPlayingAccents = [] m.programTimeLabels = [] m.initialProgramSelected = false if m.top.content = invalid then return
for channelIndex = 0 to m.top.content.getChildCount() - 1 channel = m.top.content.getChild(channelIndex) row = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") row.translation = [0, channelIndex * m.rowHeight] programs = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") programs.translation = [m.channelWidth + m.programGutter, 0] row.appendChild(programs) channelTiles = [] channelFocus = [] channelAccents = [] channelTimeLabels = [] x = 0 for programIndex = 0 to channel.getChildCount() - 1 program = channel.getChild(programIndex) width = programWidth(program.durationSeconds) tileResult = createProgramTile(program, width) tile = tileResult.tile tile.translation = [x, 0] programs.appendChild(tile) channelTiles.push(tile) channelFocus.push(tileResult.focus) channelAccents.push(tileResult.nowPlayingAccent) channelTimeLabels.push(tileResult.time) x += width + 10 end for appendChannelCard(row, channel)
m.rows.appendChild(row) m.rowNodes.push(row) m.programGroups.push(programs) m.programTiles.push(channelTiles) m.focusRects.push(channelFocus) m.nowPlayingAccents.push(channelAccents) m.programTimeLabels.push(channelTimeLabels) end for if m.channelIndex >= m.rowNodes.count() then m.channelIndex = m.rowNodes.count() - 1 if m.channelIndex < 0 then m.channelIndex = 0 end sub
sub appendChannelCard(row as object, channel as object) card = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") cardWidth = m.channelWidth + m.programGutter - int(m.focusBorderThickness / 2) background = card.createChild("Rectangle") background.width = cardWidth background.height = 170 background.color = "#182331"
poster = card.createChild("Poster") poster.width = cardWidth poster.height = 170 poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" poster.uri = channel.HDPosterUrl
overlay = card.createChild("Rectangle") overlay.translation = [0, 80] overlay.width = cardWidth overlay.height = 90 overlay.color = "#CC000000"
title = card.createChild("Label") title.translation = [18, 88] title.width = cardWidth - 36 title.height = 36 title.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" title.color = "#FFFFFF" title.text = channel.title
description = card.createChild("Label") description.translation = [18, 127] description.width = cardWidth - 36 description.height = 30 description.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" description.color = "#D7E0EA" description.text = channel.description
edge = card.createChild("Rectangle") edge.translation = [cardWidth - 2, 0] edge.width = 2 edge.height = 170 edge.color = "#34485D" row.appendChild(card) end sub
function createProgramTile(program as object, width as integer) as object tile = createObject("roSGNode", "Group") tile.addFields({ guideWidth: width isNowPlaying: false })
background = tile.createChild("Rectangle") background.width = width background.height = 170 background.color = "#202E3D"
poster = tile.createChild("Poster") poster.translation = [2, 2] poster.width = width - 4 poster.height = 112 poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" if program.HDPosterUrl <> "" poster.uri = program.HDPosterUrl else poster.uri = "pkg:/images/video_placeholder.png" poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToFit" end if
footer = tile.createChild("Rectangle") footer.translation = [0, 112] footer.width = width footer.height = 58 footer.color = "#E6182331"
title = tile.createChild("Label") title.translation = [12, 116] title.width = width - 24 title.height = 28 title.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" title.color = "#FFFFFF" title.text = program.title
time = tile.createChild("Label") time.translation = [12, 143] time.width = width - 24 time.height = 24 time.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" time.color = "#9DB0C3" time.text = program.startTimeText
nowPlayingAccent = tile.createChild("Group") nowPlayingAccent.opacity = 0.0 appendBorder(nowPlayingAccent, width, 3, m.nowPlayingColor)
focus = tile.createChild("Group") focus.opacity = 0.0 appendBorder(focus, width, m.focusBorderThickness, m.defaultFocusColor) return { tile: tile focus: focus nowPlayingAccent: nowPlayingAccent time: time } end function
sub appendBorder(group as object, width as integer, thickness as integer, color as string) offset = int(thickness / 2) topBorder = group.createChild("Rectangle") topBorder.translation = [-offset, -offset] topBorder.width = width + (offset * 2) topBorder.height = thickness topBorder.color = color bottomBorder = group.createChild("Rectangle") bottomBorder.translation = [-offset, 170 - offset] bottomBorder.width = width + (offset * 2) bottomBorder.height = thickness bottomBorder.color = color leftBorder = group.createChild("Rectangle") leftBorder.translation = [-offset, -offset] leftBorder.width = thickness leftBorder.height = 170 + (offset * 2) leftBorder.color = color rightBorder = group.createChild("Rectangle") rightBorder.translation = [width - offset, -offset] rightBorder.width = thickness rightBorder.height = 170 + (offset * 2) rightBorder.color = color end sub
function programWidth(durationSeconds as integer) as integer if durationSeconds >= m.maximumProgramDurationSeconds then return m.maximumProgramWidth width = int(durationSeconds * m.maximumProgramWidth / m.maximumProgramDurationSeconds) if width < m.minimumProgramWidth then width = m.minimumProgramWidth return width end function
sub onNowPlayingTimer() updateNowPlaying() if m.followNow m.browseTimeSeconds = localTimestampSeconds() m.programIndex = programIndexAtTime(m.channelIndex, m.browseTimeSeconds, m.programIndex) end if updateFocus() end sub
sub updateNowPlaying() if m.top.content = invalid then return nowSeconds = localTimestampSeconds() for channelIndex = 0 to m.top.content.getChildCount() - 1 channel = m.top.content.getChild(channelIndex) for programIndex = 0 to channel.getChildCount() - 1 program = channel.getChild(programIndex) isNowPlaying = program.startTimeSeconds >= 0 and nowSeconds >= program.startTimeSeconds and nowSeconds < program.startTimeSeconds + program.durationSeconds tile = m.programTiles[channelIndex][programIndex] tile.isNowPlaying = isNowPlaying accent = m.nowPlayingAccents[channelIndex][programIndex] time = m.programTimeLabels[channelIndex][programIndex] if isNowPlaying accent.opacity = 1.0 time.text = "NOW PLAYING" time.color = m.nowPlayingColor else accent.opacity = 0.0 time.text = program.startTimeText time.color = "#9DB0C3" end if end for end for end sub
sub selectInitialProgram() if m.initialProgramSelected or m.programTiles.count() = 0 then return m.followNow = true m.browseTimeSeconds = localTimestampSeconds() m.programIndex = programIndexAtTime(0, m.browseTimeSeconds, 0) m.initialProgramSelected = true end sub
function programIndexAtTime(channelIndex as integer, targetSeconds as integer, fallback as integer) as integer if m.top.content = invalid or channelIndex < 0 or channelIndex >= m.top.content.getChildCount() then return fallback channel = m.top.content.getChild(channelIndex) if channel = invalid or channel.getChildCount() = 0 then return fallback
closestIndex = 0 for programIndex = 0 to channel.getChildCount() - 1 program = channel.getChild(programIndex) if program.startTimeSeconds >= 0 if targetSeconds < program.startTimeSeconds then return closestIndex closestIndex = programIndex if targetSeconds < program.startTimeSeconds + program.durationSeconds then return programIndex end if end for return closestIndex end function
sub updateBrowseTimeFromSelection() tile = m.programTiles[m.channelIndex][m.programIndex] if tile.isNowPlaying m.followNow = true m.browseTimeSeconds = localTimestampSeconds() return end if
m.followNow = false program = m.top.content.getChild(m.channelIndex).getChild(m.programIndex) if program.startTimeSeconds >= 0 then m.browseTimeSeconds = program.startTimeSeconds end sub
function localTimestampSeconds() as integer current = createObject("roDateTime") current.mark() current.toLocalTime() return calendarTimestampSeconds( current.getYear(), current.getMonth(), current.getDayOfMonth(), current.getHours(), current.getMinutes(), current.getSeconds() ) end function
function calendarTimestampSeconds(year as integer, month as integer, day as integer, hour as integer, minute as integer, second as integer) as integer days = 0 for currentYear = 1970 to year - 1 days += 365 if isLeapYear(currentYear) then days++ end for monthDays = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31] if isLeapYear(year) then monthDays[1] = 29 if month > 1 for currentMonth = 0 to month - 2 days += monthDays[currentMonth] end for end if days += day - 1 return days * 86400 + hour * 3600 + minute * 60 + second end function
function isLeapYear(year as integer) as boolean return (year mod 4 = 0 and year mod 100 <> 0) or year mod 400 = 0 end function
sub focusGuide() m.top.setFocus(true) updateFocus() end sub
sub updateFocus() for each channelFocus in m.focusRects for each focus in channelFocus focus.opacity = 0.0 end for end for if m.focusRects.count() = 0 then return if m.programIndex >= m.focusRects[m.channelIndex].count() m.programIndex = m.focusRects[m.channelIndex].count() - 1 end if if m.focusRects[m.channelIndex].count() = 0 then return minimumIndex = minimumBrowsableProgramIndex(m.channelIndex) if m.programIndex < minimumIndex m.programIndex = minimumIndex updateBrowseTimeFromSelection() end if if m.programIndex < 0 then m.programIndex = 0 if m.focusRects[m.channelIndex].count() > 0 focus = m.focusRects[m.channelIndex][m.programIndex] tile = m.programTiles[m.channelIndex][m.programIndex] focusColor = m.defaultFocusColor if tile.isNowPlaying then focusColor = m.nowPlayingColor for borderIndex = 0 to focus.getChildCount() - 1 focus.getChild(borderIndex).color = focusColor end for focus.opacity = 1.0 end if updateProgramDetails() updateVerticalScroll() updateHorizontalScroll() end sub
sub updateProgramDetails() m.detailPoster.uri = "" m.detailTitle.text = "" m.detailTime.text = "" m.detailDescription.text = "" if m.top.content = invalid or m.channelIndex >= m.top.content.getChildCount() then return channel = m.top.content.getChild(m.channelIndex) if channel = invalid or m.programIndex >= channel.getChildCount() then return program = channel.getChild(m.programIndex) if program = invalid then return
m.detailTitle.text = program.title m.detailDescription.text = program.description if m.detailDescription.text = "" then m.detailDescription.text = channel.description if program.HDPosterUrl <> "" m.detailPoster.uri = program.HDPosterUrl else m.detailPoster.uri = "pkg:/images/video_placeholder.png" end if m.detailTime.text = program.startTimeText + " " + relativeProgramTime(program) end sub
function relativeProgramTime(program as object) as string if program.startTimeSeconds < 0 then return formatDuration(program.durationSeconds) nowSeconds = localTimestampSeconds() endSeconds = program.startTimeSeconds + program.durationSeconds if nowSeconds < program.startTimeSeconds return "Starts in " + formatDuration(program.startTimeSeconds - nowSeconds) else if nowSeconds < endSeconds return formatDuration(endSeconds - nowSeconds) + " left" end if return "Ended" end function
function programHasEnded(program as object, nowSeconds as integer) as boolean return program <> invalid and program.startTimeSeconds >= 0 and nowSeconds >= program.startTimeSeconds + program.durationSeconds end function
function programStartsInFuture(program as object, nowSeconds as integer) as boolean return program <> invalid and program.startTimeSeconds >= 0 and nowSeconds < program.startTimeSeconds end function
function minimumBrowsableProgramIndex(channelIndex as integer) as integer currentIndex = programIndexAtTime(channelIndex, localTimestampSeconds(), 0) minimumIndex = currentIndex - m.maximumPreviousProgramSlots if minimumIndex < 0 then return 0 return minimumIndex end function
function formatDuration(seconds as integer) as string if seconds < 60 then return "less than a minute" minutes = int((seconds + 59) / 60) hours = int(minutes / 60) remainingMinutes = minutes mod 60 if hours = 0 then return minutes.toStr() + " min" if remainingMinutes = 0 then return hours.toStr() + " hr" return hours.toStr() + " hr " + remainingMinutes.toStr() + " min" end function
sub updateVerticalScroll() firstVisible = m.channelIndex - int(m.visibleRows / 2) maxFirst = m.rowNodes.count() - m.visibleRows if maxFirst < 0 then maxFirst = 0 if firstVisible < 0 then firstVisible = 0 if firstVisible > maxFirst then firstVisible = maxFirst m.rows.translation = [0, -(firstVisible * m.rowHeight)] end sub
sub updateHorizontalScroll() if m.programGroups.count() = 0 or m.programTiles[m.channelIndex].count() = 0 then return for channelIndex = 0 to m.programGroups.count() - 1 if m.programTiles[channelIndex].count() > 0 alignedIndex = programIndexAtTime(channelIndex, m.browseTimeSeconds, 0) tile = m.programTiles[channelIndex][alignedIndex] targetX = tile.translation[0] if not m.followNow program = m.top.content.getChild(channelIndex).getChild(alignedIndex) elapsedSeconds = m.browseTimeSeconds - program.startTimeSeconds if elapsedSeconds > 0 and program.durationSeconds > 0 targetX += int(elapsedSeconds * tile.guideWidth / program.durationSeconds) end if end if m.programGroups[channelIndex].translation = [m.channelWidth + m.programGutter - targetX, 0] end if end for end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if m.rowNodes.count() = 0 then return false if key = "up" if m.channelIndex > 0 m.channelIndex-- m.programIndex = programIndexAtTime(m.channelIndex, m.browseTimeSeconds, 0) end if updateFocus() return true else if key = "down" if m.channelIndex + 1 < m.rowNodes.count() m.channelIndex++ m.programIndex = programIndexAtTime(m.channelIndex, m.browseTimeSeconds, 0) end if updateFocus() return true else if key = "right" if m.programIndex + 1 < m.programTiles[m.channelIndex].count() m.programIndex++ updateBrowseTimeFromSelection() end if updateFocus() return true else if key = "left" minimumIndex = minimumBrowsableProgramIndex(m.channelIndex) if m.programIndex > minimumIndex m.programIndex-- updateBrowseTimeFromSelection() updateFocus() else m.top.menuRequested = true end if return true else if key = "OK" channel = m.top.content.getChild(m.channelIndex) if channel <> invalid and m.programIndex < channel.getChildCount() program = channel.getChild(m.programIndex) nowSeconds = localTimestampSeconds() if programHasEnded(program, nowSeconds) or programStartsInFuture(program, nowSeconds) m.followNow = true m.browseTimeSeconds = nowSeconds m.programIndex = programIndexAtTime(m.channelIndex, nowSeconds, m.programIndex) updateFocus() return true end if end if m.top.channelSelected = m.channelIndex return true end if return false end function
